name: Read board
summary: Finds the printed board in a camera picture by its markers, straightens it, cuts the 9 cells and reads them with the board reader.
help: Without Pictures it takes them with a camera of the machine (Camera: 0, 1 … or a device path or stream address). Connect the models (reader.pt) to read the cells: the log and the live picture show X, O or empty in each, with how sure the reader is. Without models it only checks that the board is found and straight: use it to place the camera and the light. Real cells read with the reader are saved as cells/real_cells_*.npz (same format as Render cells): check them before training on them. Live: board (straightened picture with the reading), camera (when the board is not found), read (matrix of confidences).
